descriptionChirho: Intransitive Qal sense of physical growth and maturation, said of children, young people, or plants growing up over time (Hebrew כָּבַר/גָּדַל in the sense of 'grew up'). Multilingual glosses: eng 'grew up', spa 'creció/crecieron', hin 'बड़े हुए', arb 'كَبِرَ/كَبُرُوا', kor '자랐다'.

Stative Qal sense expressing that someone or something is great, large, or important -- a state of greatness rather than a process. Glosses: eng 'great is / you are great / was great', spa 'sea engrandecido / eres grande / era grande', hin 'बड़ा है', arb 'يَتَعاظَمُ / عَظُمَ', kor '크시도다 / 크신다'.

Dynamic Qal sense of becoming great, growing in power, status, or magnitude -- the process of increasing in importance or size (not mere physical growth of youth). Glosses: eng 'became great / will be great / I became great', spa 'se engrandeció / será grande', hin 'बड़ा हुआ / बड़ा होगा', arb 'عَظُمَ / يَعْظُمُ', kor '커졌다 / 크리라'.

Piel factitive sense of nurturing, raising, or rearing children or dependents -- bringing them up from youth to maturity. Glosses: eng 'reared / raised / bringing up', spa 'crié / crió / criando', hin 'पाला / मैंने पाला', arb 'رَبَّيتُ / رَبَّى / يُرَبُّونَ', kor '키웠다 / 양육하는', swa 'aliwalea / nimewalea'.

Piel declarative/factitive sense of magnifying, making great, or extolling someone -- declaring or causing greatness, honor, or glory. Glosses: eng 'magnify / made great / magnified', spa 'engrandeced / engrandeció / engrandeceré', hin 'बड़ाई करो / बड़ा किया', arb 'عَظِّموا / عَظَّمَ / أُعَظِّمُ', kor '높이라 / 크게 했다'.

labelChirho: Hifil: make great, do great things
descriptionChirho: Hifil causative sense of making something or someone great, performing great deeds, or increasing greatness. Glosses: eng 'made great / has done great things / you have magnified', spa 'engrandeció / ha engrandecido / aumentaste', hin 'बड़ा किया / बड़े काम किए', arb 'عَظَّمَ / أَعْظَمَ', kor '크게 하셨다'.

Reflexive sense (Hifil reflexive or Hitpael) of magnifying oneself, exalting oneself, or boasting -- often with negative connotation of arrogance or self-aggrandizement. Glosses: eng 'magnified himself / magnify yourselves / those magnifying themselves', spa 'se engrandeció / se engrandecerá', hin 'बड़ा बना / बड़ा करेगा अपने आपको', arb 'تَكَبَّرَ / يَتَعَظَّمُ / تَعاظَموا', kor '큰 체하였다 / 자랑하였도다'.

Pual passive participle indicating the state of having been grown or raised -- the passive counterpart of the Piel 'raise/rear'. Glosses: eng 'grown up', spa 'crecidas', hin 'बड़े हुए', arb 'نَامِيَةٍ', kor '자란'.
Adjectival use (possibly a Qere/Ketiv variant or participial adjective) meaning 'great' as an attribute. Glosses: eng 'and great of', spa 'y grande de', hin 'और बड़ा', arb 'وَعَظِيمُ', kor '그리고 크시고'.
